name: A little room
thesis: An intimate literary reading room gives each story a centered serif title, a generous photographic pause, and one warm invitation to read.
difference: Newsreader leads the wordmark, headlines, descriptions and navigation; a plum ink accent sits on softly lit ivory, photographs have broad rounded corners, story metadata rests beneath the primary action, and a translucent floating five-destination dock keeps the edges useful.
tradeoff: The five-item dock preserves immediate access but uses more vertical space than a session-only interface; centered literary typography also favors deliberate reading over fast scanning.
lens: A contemporary literary magazine art director designing a genuinely native-feeling phone experience, serif-led and analog, with a clear center of attention.
